onboarding.title: Complete these first
onboarding.profile: Update your person profile with accurate contact, church, location, and family details. This stays here until it is done. You cannot pay for a camp until your profile is complete.

landing.waitingListBody: This is for interested people who do not have a trophy and still want to take part. Complete the person details step by step, then wait for an administrator to review your request. Approval adds you to the people directory with trophies set to No. It does not create an account.
landing.sponsorsBody: Give toward a camp or day event. Share your name and email, choose whether to stay anonymous, then pay from your phone. A receipt is sent to the email you provide once the payment is confirmed.
landing.headline: Young Foundations Cameroon
landing.description: Encouraging young Christians in their walk with Christ. A fellowship anchored in the Word brought by God’s prophet, William Marrion Branham, not bound by doctrine or separated by churches.
landing.featurePeopleBody: Founded in 2006 after the Lord placed a burden on Brother Joseph’s heart: an avenue for young people throughout the world to draw strength from each other. The message is simple: place God and His Word first, stay away from the world, encourage each other, and believe God’s prophet.
landing.featureEventsBody: Launched in 2013 for craft, woodshop, and sewing centered on the Message. Today Creations shares video classes, projects, and homeschooling resources in English, French, Portuguese, and Spanish, for every age and location.
landing.featureInvitesBody: Since 2008, Cub Corner has helped younger believers stay in the Word through Bible and Brother Branham stories, trivia, fun facts, and pictures.
landing.quote: Place God and His Word first in all things, stay away from the world, encourage each other, and believe God’s prophet.
landing.footerTagline: Young Foundations fellowship across Cameroon: camps, Creations, and Cub Corner.
landing.eventsEmpty: Published camps and Creations gatherings will appear here.
